item.title: Looking for artists to sell/license their word art/fonts for resale
item.description:
Hi,

Are you a pro with sketches/doodles lying around you wouldn’t mind sharing/selling? A budding type designer with a promising font, but not wanting to take the time to digitize it and take it to market?

I’m getting started in digitizing files for DIY type patterns/projects/scrapbooking etc to be sold online. Files do NOT have to be rendered as vector or be an actual working font.

I cannot pay much as I’m just getting started, but would love to get a conversation going with interested artists. Please include samples of your work and what you’re expecting in terms of payment and licensing allowances.

item.title: Request for freelance typographer (paid work)
item.description:
Hello

Yesterday I released www.comicneue.com. Last night it was trending worldwide on Twitter, was featured on the front page of Mashable, Reddit, Hacker News, The Verge, everything! It has been downloaded well over 10,000 times in the last 24 hours, and there are an average rate of 800 people viewing the site at any one time.

I created the font in TypeTool, the cut down version of Font Lab. It was a two year side-project and I put a hell of a lot of work into it, but it needs a final polish from someone far more experienced than I am.

item.title: What Is The Complete Work of Herb Lubalin?
item.description:

item.title: Seeking typographer to finish my typeface
